title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Allegheny College
description: Late-night dining at Allegheny College is defined by a mix of on-campus food courts, 24/7 convenience markets, and local Meadville staples that have served students for decades.

cards.title: McKinley's Food Court
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Campus Hub
cards.notes: Located in the Henderson Campus Center, this food court stays open until 12:30 AM on weekends, serving burgers, fries, and pizza to students.
cards.short_summary: The primary late-night dining destination on campus, featuring multiple food stations and mobile ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: McKinley's Food Court is open until 10:30 PM Monday-Thursday and Sunday, and until 12:30 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:30 AM on Friday and Saturday; 10:30 PM other nights.

cards.title: 360 Market
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Convenience in Brooks Hall
cards.notes: This self-checkout market in Brooks Hall provides 24/7 access to snacks, beverages, and grocery staples for residential students.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 on-campus convenience store offering grab-and-go meals and household essentials.
cards.evidence_claim: The 360 Market is a 24/7 convenience store located in Brooks Hall.
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 for students with campus ID.

cards.title: Grounds for Change
cards.subtitle: Student-Run Coffeehouse
cards.notes: A student-run, non-profit coffeehouse in the Campus Center that serves as a late-night study and social space until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A volunteer-run coffeehouse known for its sustainable practices and alcohol-free social atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Grounds for Change is open until 12:00 AM Monday through Thursday and on Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM most nights; closes at 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Sheetz
cards.subtitle: The 24/7 MTO Classic
cards.notes: A regional staple where students go for Made-To-Order (MTO) burgers, fries, and snacks at any hour of the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store and kitchen that serves as a primary off-campus late-night food source.
cards.evidence_claim: Sheetz offers Made-To-Order food and beverages 24/7/365.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Drive-Thru
cards.notes: The Park Avenue location is a go-to for late-night cravings, with a drive-thru that stays open until 4:00 AM.
cards.short_summary: A popular fast-food chain near campus known for its extremely late drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 1228 Park Ave in Meadville is open until 4:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Meadville, PA - 1228 Park Ave

cards.title: Domino's Pizza
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Delivery Staple
cards.notes: A reliable delivery option for students studying late, with service extending until 2:00 AM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: The local Domino's provides late-night pizza delivery and carryout to the Allegheny campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Domino's on Willow Street is open until 1:00 AM Sunday-Thursday and 2:00 AM Friday-Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2:00 AM on Friday and Saturday; 1:00 AM other nights.

cards.title: Denny's
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Study Diner
cards.notes: A classic 24-hour diner that serves as an off-campus study spot with bottomless coffee and full breakfast menus.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 diner popular for late-night study sessions and group meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's is a 24-hour diner and breakfast restaurant.

cards.title: McDonald's
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Fast Food
cards.notes: The Park Avenue McDonald's offers late-night drive-thru service, providing a quick meal option for students near campus.
cards.short_summary: A standard late-night fast-food option with extended drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 1060 Park Ave offers late-night drive-thru service.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open late; check app for specific nightly closing times.

cards.title: Food Resource Center
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Student Pantry
cards.notes: A student-led initiative providing 24/7 access to refrigerated produce and dry goods for any student in need.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 food pantry on the third floor of the Campus Center aimed at combating food insecurity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Food Resource Center is a 24/7 resource for students located on the third floor of the campus center.
cards.source_title: Food Resource Center opens with fridge, food staples - The Campus
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 whenever the Campus Center is accessible.

cards.title: Hank's Frozen Custard
cards.subtitle: Seasonal Evening Tradition
cards.notes: A seasonal Meadville tradition since 1952, students visit for fresh-made frozen custard until 11:00 PM during the summer.
cards.short_summary: A historic local custard stand that is a popular evening destination for students during the warmer months.
cards.evidence_claim: Hank's Frozen Custard is open until 11:00 PM daily from Memorial Day to the end of the season.
cards.source_title: Hank's Frozen Custard - Explore PA History
cards.access_notes: Open seasonally; 11:00 PM closing time during peak summer months.
